profile.headline: Software Engineer II at Microsoft
profile.summary: Innovative problem-solver, leveraging deep understanding of advanced mathematics, data analytics, and programming to drive solutions and create impact. Seeking opportunities that will build on my passion for technology and data while forcing me to learn and giving me room to grow.

positions.title: Communications Manager
positions.description:
•	Providing operational and technical assessment communications to Microsoft customers and internal leadership related to high-severity Dynamics 365 outages and business-impacting events, on-site at Microsoft.
•	Partnering with Dynamics Operations Center engineers to identify and solve availability and functionality issues in LiveSite technical bridges, documenting the restoration details of and providing management with an accurate timeline.

positions.title: Business Operations Analyst
positions.description:
•	Optimized and automated ticket processing tasks in Zendesk using Ruby and the Zendesk REST API
•	Built scraping scripts using the Ruby gems Mechanize and Capybara with Poltergeist to gather chargeback information for representment. 
•	Engineered process to reduce risk of failed payments that led to the creation of a new position within the company
•	Developed an automated reporting systems to supply Geckoboard dashboards using Elastic Search and Google Sheets
•	Worked with consultant to redefine chargeback business process improving dispute success rate

positions.title: Developer - Corporate IT
positions.description: Recruited to return after successful internship the previous year. Implemented an automated system that configured virtual-machine template clones (servers), bringing them up to compliance and security standards and deploying as CRM servers. Significantly reduced errors in the creation of new servers and eliminated the need for manual intervention.

positions.title: Intern - Corporate IT
positions.description: Introduced to PowerShell scripting, which became main tool for various projects. Automated active-directory user creation and customization via powershell script. Introduced to web development in asp.NET and built a web-tool for managing active-directory group and user membership.

positions.title: Cashier Customer Service
positions.description: General cashier, member of "front-end" team which was responsible for holding the presentation of the store to a high standard and setting up semi-weekly events. Helped organize the distribution of workload and plan tasks to fit daily schedule.

positions.title: Sales Associate
positions.description: Worked with customers to solve their problems and point them in the right direction for solutions. Also shared store-management responsibilities in opening and closing, monitoring the register, and working with the regional manager to implement new policies.

positions.title: Camp Counselor
positions.description: Worked as an after-school counselor during the school year and as a camp counselor during the summer. Devised activities for and managed at least ten kids per counselor at a time, and learned patience and assertiveness.

company.name: Boys and Girls Clubs of America

positions.title: Courtesy Clerk
positions.description: Focused on customer needs, providing assistance in several ways and escalating request to those with more authority if necessary. Assisted in store maintenance and aesthetics.

honors.title: Eagle Scout
honors.description: Eagle Scout is the highest achievement or rank attainable in the Boy Scouting program of the Boy Scouts of America. Only a small percentage of Boy Scouts are granted this rank after a lengthy review process.
honors.issuer: Issued by Boy Scouts of America · Oct 2010

honors.title: Senior Class Vice President
honors.description: Responsible for planning school events and managing the senior class budget.
